title: "Rooms" is a product feature: conversations several people share with an AI agent. Keep the noun consistent.
intro: A company socio is an AI agent the whole company shares.
enable.title: Switch on the Rooms card: lets workspace members create rooms (conversations several people share with a socio, an AI agent).
enable.saved: Toast after the switch saved; the _off form is for when it was turned off.
budget.title: Switch: members see how much of the room's limits (time, tokens, spend) is used.
budget.saved: Toast after the switch saved; the _off form is for when it was turned off.
readiness.allPrivate: Shown to admins before they turn Rooms on: how many of the workspace's chats are private and how many are rooms.
readiness.mixed: {{chats}} is readiness.chats and {{rooms}} is readiness.rooms, with their numbers.
readiness.chats: Inserted as {{chats}} into readiness.mixed: how many private chats the workspace has. {{count}} is that number.
readiness.rooms: Inserted as {{rooms}} into readiness.mixed: how many rooms the workspace has. {{count}} is that number.
requests.title: Heading: AI agents (socios) that rooms asked to have let in.
requests.request: {{socio}} is the AI agent's name, shown in bold (keep the <socio> tags around it); {{room}} is the room's title.
requests.askedByAdmin: Line under a request to let a socio (AI agent) into a room, shown instead of "Asked by {{name}}" when a room admin asked.
requests.letIn: Button: lets the socio (AI agent) answer in that room.
requests.letInLabel: Screen reader label of the Let in button. {{socio}} is the agent's name, {{room}} the room's title.
requests.letInDone: Toast after Let in: {{socio}} is the AI agent’s name, {{room}} the room’s title.
requests.letInFailed: Error toast when letting the socio (AI agent) into the room failed.
